# Task: PR #7271 (#7139 empty-host alarm) — add the cross-feature regression test the merge with #7270 created (epic #7177, M4).

Evidence rule (#M-4): back every claim with a command you ran. Commit on the attached branch `cursor/monitor-7139-empty-host-alarm`
(no push credentials — main pushes). Ruff on every changed .py (tests included). Run the repo-wide guards before finishing:
tests/test_lint_test_assertions.py tests/api/test_import_pinning.py tests/test_subprocess_timeout_guard.py.

## Why
After merging #7270 (observer presence seats, `instance_id`, mac-operator host) into this branch, `/api/occupancy` now has an
interaction no test covers (cross-family review MAJOR): an observer seat whose `status != "idle"` forces `burn_state: "active"` →
`idle_or_empty: False` → the empty-host alarm is suppressed / idle-since resets; an IDLE observer seat leaves `burn_state: idle` →
`idle_or_empty: True` → `empty_host_underused:<host>` (or `empty_host_unknown_capacity:<host>`) may still fire. Read
`scripts/api/occupancy.py` (`_evaluate_attention`, `_empty_host_attention_item`, the burn_state derivation around the observer-seat
branch) and the existing `tests/api/test_empty_host_alarm.py` + `tests/api/test_notebook_presence.py` fixtures before writing.

## Outcome
One new test module or two new tests in `tests/api/test_empty_host_alarm.py` using the existing fixtures/seams (no real subprocess,
no network): (a) idle observer seat on a host with a lane under pace → `attention` contains `empty_host_underused:<host>`;
(b) the same host with a non-idle observer seat → that item is ABSENT and `burn_state == "active"`. Use the real request path
(unmocked `TestClient` GET after seeding presence + lane usage through the same entry points the reporters use).

## Mutation check (report the evidence)
Temporarily make the observer-seat branch ignore `status` (treat every seat as idle) → test (b) must FAIL; restore → both pass.

## Constraints
Tests only; do not change `scripts/api/`. Do not touch other files. No new fixtures that duplicate existing ones.

## Report
Commit SHA, test names, passing lines, and the mutation-check output.

## Research registry classification
Test addition for a monitor API interaction — no research dimension; pointer-free by deliberate classification.

I'll add the cross-feature regression tests for observer-seat interaction with the empty-host alarm. Starting with cold start and reading the relevant occupancy code and existing tests.
